build_olmo_hybrid_model: build an inference-only OLMo Hybrid model with Gated DeltaNet linear attention for vLLM
create_gated_delta_net_layer: create a Gated DeltaNet linear attention layer replacing sliding window attention in the hybrid architecture
implement_olmo_hybrid_attention: implement OLMo Hybrid attention with QKV projections, RMSNorm, rotary embeddings, and output projection
run_custom_op_forward: run the custom op olmo_hybrid_gdn_full_forward to prevent inductor numerical divergence in the recurrent state
fused_gdn_gating_computation: fused GDN gating computation using triton kernel to compute g and beta from A_log, a, b, and dt_bias
